newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian St Petersburg Telephone proposes dividends.
newsitem.headline: Russian St Petersburg Telephone proposes dividends.

text.p: The board of directors of St Petersburg Telephone (PTS) has recommended 1996 divends of 170 roubles for privileged shares and 16 roubles for ordinaries, an official said on Monday.
Mikhail Rozenberg, head of securities at PTS, said shareholders would vote on the recommendation at AO Peterburgskaya Telefonaya Set's annual meeting on April 18.
Net profit, according to Russian accruals standards, rose to 198.1 billion roubles in 1996 from 150.8 billion in 1995 on sales of 875.5 billion and 513.7 billion, respectively.
Shareholders will also consider increasing the authorised capital with a view toward issuing new shares.
